$comment: The site's route registry. Keys of `routes` are routes (file: src/content/docs/<route>.md). `status`: stub (placeholder, rewritten by `bun run stubs`) | draft (prose not yet checked against the product — the verbatim MkDocs port or an unverified edit) | written (written by the /docs-explore pipeline and passed its gates) | adopted (a human checked it; set by hand, with `reviewedAt` + `reviewedRun`; the pipeline never downgrades it). `type`: the page contract (scripts/agentic/contract.ts). `console`: the console areas whose captures a route is written from (first = owner). `gaps`: what the page must still cover; `gapsResolved`: gaps a capture disproved (never documented as absences). `redirects`: old MkDocs URL → new route, kept for the documentation.neuralseek.com cutover (scripts/url-inventory.ts). `renamed`: old route → new route or prose.

getting-started/what-is-neuralseek.title: What is NeuralSeek
getting-started/what-is-neuralseek.description: NeuralSeek answers questions from your own KnowledgeBase with a large language model, shows the sources behind each answer, and lets you build no-code LLM routines in mAIstro — this page walks through the Home screen and each navbar item.
